profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | BU Head Technology Solutions
profile.summary:
Understanding Client Requirements and proposing suitable web solution for it.
liaising with the client to keep track of the requirement changes at various stages of the project.
Creating websites from scratch, be it static, dynamic or e-commerce.
Successfully developing a completely customized administration panel for my client, to manage its distributors, wholesalers, online products, newsletter broadcasting and invoice generation and its management.

Specialties: PHP - MySQL, XHTML, CSS, javascript, jquery
Frameworks: Symfony2.1, CodeIgniter 2.1
APIs: google Visualization and google Map

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my role as a software engineer, I've traversed diverse landscapes, each project a chapter in my journey of digital innovation.

It started with optimization of Bright Plan apps, a web application crafted with Node.js & React powered by headless CMS for which I defined data structures. Soon Azure technologies became my canvas, where I was part of the team behind engineering a high-performance member portal integrated with Service Bus, C# function apps, and third-party web-hooks.

API development emerged as my core strength. I engineered robust C# REST APIs, ensuring seamless data delivery for internal applications. My expertise extended to GraphQL APIs, tailored to diverse member needs. 

Then my journey led me into the intricate world of big data. Scala, Apache Spark, Databricks, HIVE, and Datalake became my tools. Developing idempotent Keystone ETLs became a crucial aspect, guaranteeing precision and reliability in data processing.

Infrastructure management played a pivotal role. I streamlined deployment processes through Docker and Kubernetes, embracing Infrastructure as Code principles. ARM templates and Azure DevOps scripts became my tools, facilitating seamless infrastructure deployments.

Implementing Scrum and Agile methodologies, I utilized tools like JIRA and Confluence, ensuring streamlined project management. Collaborative brainstorming sessions became my forte, transforming conceptual ideas into practical solutions through our agile approach.

Utilized Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Dataverse, PowerApps Flow, and PowerApps Portal, for rapid application development and customizations using plugins. Maintained and updated legacy eligibility and enrollment systems from acquisitions, written in VB forms and .Net Framework 3.0 – 3.5.

This multifaceted journey has significantly contributed to my growth, shaping me into a seasoned technologist prepared for the challenges of the ever-evolving digital landscape.

positions.title: BU Head - Technology Solutions
positions.description:
In my role as a strategic technology leader, I drive our company's growth with a keen focus on optimizing tech operations and fostering innovation. Collaborating closely with executive peers, I craft comprehensive plans that align seamlessly with our company's overarching goals. Managing development teams and projects, I meticulously optimize our operations, integrating services effectively, reducing infrastructure costs, and enhancing the quality of our deliverables.

A significant aspect of my role revolves around standardizing our tech infrastructure. I set the direction on tooling and technology stack selection, ensuring standardization and innovation. Utilizing battle tested technologies, I orchestrate the creation of modular and scalable e-commerce, custom and enterprise applications.

I also play a pivotal role in addressing technical challenges. From resolving escalated technical issues to conducting Knowledge Transfer sessions, I ensure our solutions are not only robust but also globally aligned. My hands-on expertise spans from Unix command line interface to server-side operations, guaranteeing superior performance in our applications.

Furthermore, my client-centric approach reflects in the innovative solutions I design for client applications. I focus not just on addressing challenges but also on ensuring optimal user experiences. In essence, my role encompasses strategic vision, technical prowess, and hands-on expertise, ensuring our solutions are not just technologically advanced but also user-friendly and future-ready.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
I work on different aspects in web application development life cycle. Mostly creating back-end functionality for new applications, upgrading existing applications. Troubleshooting and debugging front-end and backend web application bugs and issues. Working on multiple project simultaneously. We use Concrete 5 as our CMS and Laravel 3 & 4 framework for most of the applications. 
PHP5, MVC, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, jQuery UI, ajax, javascript, JSON, 3rd Pary APIs are some of the technologies I use to accomplish my day to day tasks at work.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: My role involves 80% web-based application and tool development, management of a portion of database, research better technology options and come up with good architecture & design for new tools, preparing web based reporting UI and dashboards. It involves about 20% Handling and understanding business logic to create forms and apps to reduce communication and co-ordination gaps involved in the project and change Management Process. The work environment is dynamic and the working methodology we adopt is Agile. Once a web app is developed it requires frequent updating of the features which is maintained using mercurial SVN. The technologies and methodologies that are used almost daily are PHP5, MVC, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, jQuery UI, ajax, javascript, JSON, google Visualization APIs and google Maps. We have our custom MVC framework and I also used Symfony2.0 in some projects.
